STRATEGY (15-minute, 3-minute and 1-minute candles)
Read on the previous day, the latest completed session. Candles are labelled by start time: the last candles are 15m 15:15 (second last 15:00), 3m 15:27 (second last 15:24) and 1m 15:29 (second last 15:28). A stock matches only when ALL of these hold:
1) 15m volume: the 15:00 candle's volume is higher than the 15:15 candle's.
2) 3m volume: the 15:24 candle's volume is higher than the 15:27 candle's.
3) 3m trend: the 15:24 and 15:27 candles have the same trend.
4) 1m volume: the 15:28 candle's volume is higher than the 15:29 candle's.
5) 1m trend: the 15:28 and 15:29 candles have the same trend.
6) The 15m 15:00, 3m 15:24 and 1m 15:28 candles all have the same trend.
7) The morning candles (09:15) of the 15m, 3m and 1m timeframes have that same trend too.
The 15m timeframe has no opposite-trend rule: its last two candles may have the same or opposite trends.
Trend = candle colour (close vs open); a flat candle has no trend, so it is never the same as another.
Data sources: every stock is scanned on TradingView; every stock that does not pass there is also scanned on Yahoo for the same session. A stock that passes on either source is shown as a signal, tagged with the source(s) it passed on.
Direction follows the alignment trend (the second-last candles: 15m 15:00 / 3m 15:24 / 1m 15:28): Up is LONG, Down is SHORT.
Entry: the 09:15 open on entry day. Exit: 15:27.

Data notes: candles come from the primary source (TradingView - the DATA_SOURCE setting) with Yahoo as the fallback and second source; the source of each stock is shown in the Data column. TradingView supplies its own native 15-minute, 3-minute and 1-minute candles; for NSE's feed the 15-minute and 3-minute candles are built from 1-minute candles on a 09:15 grid (open = first, close = last, volume = sum); a stock read from Yahoo uses Yahoo's own 15-minute and 1-minute feeds, with its 3-minute candles built from the 1-minute ones. Prices are rounded to 2 decimals; zero-volume and corrupt candles are dropped and count as missing, which can only block a match. DATA CONFLICT means a native 15m candle's trend, or which 15m candle has more volume, disagrees with the same candles rebuilt from the 1m candles inside them, so the symbol is blocked rather than trusted. INCOMPLETE means no completed session (or none of the nine candles) came back. STALE means the previous day differs from most other symbols. Each candle is shown as open→close with its volume so a signal can be checked against a chart.
